//: Template cho appsettings.json — copy thanh appsettings.json roi dien gia tri that.

JwtSettings.//SecretKey: Do NOT put the real key here. Local: dotnet user-secrets set "JwtSettings:SecretKey" "<32+ chars>". Server: env var JwtSettings__SecretKey.

DefaultAdmin.//: Tao tu dong tai khoan SystemAdmin sau migrations neu chua ton tai. BAT BUOC dat qua bien moi truong: DefaultAdmin__Email, DefaultAdmin__Password. De trong = khong tao.

Auth.//RequireEmailConfirmation: Temporary bypass for the SendGrid outage. Default true (verification ON). Set false / env var Auth__RequireEmailConfirmation=false while SendGrid is broken; flip back to true once it's restored — no code change needed.
